uk.s: During the reward campaign, users must enter Gate Web3 mode in the Gate App and make a staking investment of any amount of USDD or USDT in the USDD Earn protocol under the "Earn" section. Once a user completes this staking transaction, they will be considered to have successfully participated in the campaign. Specifically, the settlement cycle (1 hour) in which the user's first USDD or USDT staking transaction occurs in the USDD Earn protocol during the campaign will be regarded as the user's first reward settlement cycle.

During the campaign, at the end of each settlement cycle (1 hour), the system will record the sUSDD holdings corresponding to the staking activities conducted by participating users on the BNB network through the Gate Web3 platform, which will determine the user‘s reward share for that cycle. sUSDD obtained through other channels (including but not limited to staking on the protocol's official website or on-chain transfers) will not be included in the user's investment share for this reward campaign.

The reward token for this campaign is USDD on the BNB network. Rewards generated in the previous settlement cycle (calculated hourly) will be settled in the next settlement cycle. Settled rewards can be accumulated and claimed at any time and are not affected by the campaign end time.
Each reward settlement and synchronization of reward data to the smart contract requires a certain amount of time, so there may be a slight delay in data updates.

When staking, users can stake using either USDD or USDT. If USDT is used for staking, the smart contract will automatically convert USDT into USDD through PSM at a 1:1 exchange rate before depositing it into the protocol. Therefore, regardless of which token is used for staking, the staking receipt token will always be sUSDD.

When redeeming, whether users choose to redeem in USDT or USDD, the same staking receipt token sUSDD will be consumed. If users choose to redeem in USDT, the smart contract will automatically convert the redeemed USDD into USDT again through PSM at a 1:1 exchange rate and send it to the user's wallet address.

When users claim their rewards, the reward shown on the USDT investment product page and the USDD investment product page refers to the same reward balance. Once a user successfully claims rewards from either page, the claimable rewards on the other page will decrease by the same amount accordingly.
All investment operations in this campaign require BNB on the BNB network as gas fees. Please ensure that your wallet address has sufficient BNB balance.

Gate Web3 officially launched the Bonus earn section on December 16, 2025. Gate Web3 Bonus is a decentralized staking yield feature that supports multiple tokens, designed to provide users with a low-barrier, transparent, and fully on-chain way to grow their assets. With Gate Web3, users can participate in Bonus campaigns with one click and access flexible earning strategies to capture on-chain yield opportunities.

Following the successful conclusion of Phase 5 on ETH chain, Gate Web3 is now launching the USDD Bonus event Phase 6 on ETH chain. Users can not only earn a base 4% APY but also participate to share an extra total prize pool of 72,000 USDD.
Simply put any amount of USDD or USDT in the USDD Earn protocol on the ETH network to earn stable base 4% APY and share an extra 72,000 USDD.

Before the campaign begins, the reward system will calculate and display an estimated APY based on the total USDD TVL of the USDD Earn protocol on the ETH network and the total reward pool of this campaign. After the campaign starts, the Boost APY will be calculated in real time based only on the total amount of USDD staked within the platform by users participating in this campaign through Gate Web3. Therefore, the APY during the campaign will dynamically change depending on participation, and the final returns will be based on the real-time APY.

During the campaign, at the end of each settlement cycle (1 hour), the system will record the sUSDD holdings corresponding to the staking activities conducted by participating users on the ETH network through the Gate Web3 platform, which will determine the user‘s reward share for that cycle. sUSDD obtained through other channels (including but not limited to staking on the protocol's official website or on-chain transfers) will not be included in the user's investment share for this reward campaign.

The reward token for this campaign is USDD on the ETH network. Rewards generated in the previous settlement cycle (calculated hourly) will be settled in the next settlement cycle. Settled rewards can be accumulated and claimed at any time and are not affected by the campaign end time.
All investment operations in this campaign require ETH on the ETH network as gas fees. Please ensure that your wallet address has sufficient ETH balance.
